name: Refinish vs Replace: Running the Numbers on 800 sqft of Bellevue Oak
title-tag: Refinish vs Replace: 800 Sq Ft of Bellevue Oak, Priced
meta-description: Refinishing 800 sq ft of Bellevue oak: about $3,192. Replacing it: $5,600–$11,400+ before tear-out. Every line item, from a contractor who does both.
post-summary: October 23, 2026 · The same 800 sq ft of Bellevue oak: about $3,192 to refinish at $3.99/sq ft, versus $5,600–$11,400+ to replace once labor and materials stack up — before tear-out and disposal. Every line item priced on both sides, plus the honest cases where replacement still wins.
